about.title: About Vaidya Gogate Memorial Foundation
about.intro:
Vaidya Gogate Memorial Foundation is a website with a sole motto: Propagation of knowledge. This is a platform to share our grandfather’s, Vd. Ramchandra Ballal Gogate’s work and carry forward his vision ‘knowledge for all’. We are creating this platform as an authentic source of information. Our purpose is to ignite young minds through his writings and teachings. We plan to reach out to all vaidyas, students of Ayurved as well as disseminating the knowledge across all pathies and common people. Fortunately, our family has been blessed with renowned vaidyas for many generations.

Starting from Vd. Mahadev (Bapu) Gogate who was the rajavaidya to the king of Jawhar, next generation being Vd. Vishnu Mahadev Gogate (Dravyaguna) and Vd. Trimbak Mahadev Gogate (Panchakarma), next generation being Vd. Ramchandra Ballal Gogate (Shalya tantra), and this legacy still continues. They have made huge contributions to the field of Ayurved of which many remain under appreciated. This website is in their honor and remembrance. We intend to pass on the wisdom of these great professors. Vd. R. B. Gogate will always inspire us, not only as a grandfather but also through his lifetime of study, work and research.

We, his grandchildren on behalf of the Gogate family are creating this platform to promote our grandfather’s lifetime work and for our strong passion towards the field of Ayurved. We would definitely love to have your suggestions, guidelines and support in our endeavour!

Regards,
the grandchildren of Vd. R. B. Gogate, on behalf of the Gogate family

legacy.title: The Legacy of Vaidya R. B. Gogate
legacy.intro: This platform shares our grandfather’s, Vd. Ramchandra Ballal Gogate’s work and carries forward his vision ‘knowledge for all’. This website is in honor and remembrance of the great professors of this family.
legacy.biography:
Vd. Ramchandra Ballal Gogate (Shalya tantra) belongs to a family blessed with renowned vaidyas for many generations — starting from Vd. Mahadev (Bapu) Gogate, rajavaidya to the king of Jawhar; then Vd. Vishnu Mahadev Gogate (Dravyaguna) and Vd. Trimbak Mahadev Gogate (Panchakarma).

They have made huge contributions to the field of Ayurved of which many remain under appreciated. We intend to pass on the wisdom of these great professors. Vd. R. B. Gogate will always inspire us, not only as a grandfather but also through his lifetime of study, work and research.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: This policy explains how the Vaidya Gogate Memorial Foundation collects, uses and protects your personal information when you use our website and services.

sections.title: Information We Collect
sections.body: When you create an account, we collect your name, email address, phone number and WhatsApp number. When you place orders we collect the information needed to fulfil them, including a delivery address where applicable. We do not store payment card details on our servers; payments are processed by our payment gateway.

sections.title: How We Use Your Information
sections.body: We use your information to create and manage your account, issue a unique Account ID, communicate about events, process orders and provide support. We may send updates about events and publications when you opt in.

sections.title: Data Sharing
sections.body: We do not sell your personal information. We share data only with service providers that help us operate the website (payment, email, WhatsApp and courier services), and only to the extent needed.

sections.title: Your Rights
sections.body: You may request a copy of the personal data we hold about you, ask for corrections, or request deletion of your account by contacting us at info@vaidyagogate.org.

terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.description: By using the Vaidya Gogate Memorial Foundation website and services you agree to these terms.

sections.title: About the Foundation
sections.body: The Vaidya Gogate Memorial Foundation is a charitable organisation dedicated to Ayurveda, education and community service. This website provides information about the Foundation, its events, publications, clinics and services.

sections.title: Accounts
sections.body: To purchase books or access services you must create an account. You agree to provide accurate information and keep your login credentials secure.

sections.title: Acceptable Use
sections.body: You agree not to misuse the website, attempt unauthorised access, or use information from the website for purposes inconsistent with the Foundation's charitable mission.

sections.title: Limitation of Liability
sections.body: The Foundation does not provide medical advice through this website. Information about Ayurveda is for general awareness. For specific health concerns, consult a qualified physician.

shipping.title: Shipping Policy
shipping.description: Shipping policy for orders placed through the Vaidya Gogate Memorial Foundation online store.

sections.title: Dispatch
sections.body: Orders are dispatched within 2–4 working days of payment confirmation. You will receive tracking details once your order ships.

sections.title: Delivery Timelines
sections.body: Delivery typically takes 3–7 working days within Maharashtra and 5–12 working days elsewhere in India. International delivery is available on request.

sections.title: Shipping Charges
sections.body: Shipping is calculated at checkout based on weight and the delivery address. Orders above a stated threshold may qualify for free shipping.

returns.title: Return Policy
returns.description: How to return a book or publication purchased from the Foundation store.

sections.title: Window
sections.body: Books may be returned within 7 days of delivery if they arrived damaged, defective, or if a different title was shipped.

sections.title: Condition
sections.body: Items must be unused and in original packaging, with any included inserts. Opened digital or downloadable products cannot be returned.

sections.title: How to start a return
sections.body: Open the order in your account or write to info@vaidyagogate.org with the order number and reason. We will share the return pickup or drop-off steps.

refund.title: Refund Policy
refund.description: The refund policy for book orders placed through the Vaidya Gogate Memorial Foundation website.

sections.title: Books & Publications
sections.body: Approved returns are refunded to the original payment method. Return shipping for our error is borne by the Foundation.

sections.title: How Refunds Are Processed
sections.body: Approved refunds are processed within 7–10 working days. Your bank may take additional time to post the credit.

cancellation.title: Cancellation Policy
cancellation.description: How orders placed through the Vaidya Gogate Memorial Foundation store can be cancelled.

sections.title: Customer cancellations
sections.body: If cancellations are enabled in the store settings, you may cancel an order from your account within the stated window — typically before the order is packed or shipped. A cancellation fee may apply if one is published at checkout.

sections.title: After dispatch or delivery
sections.body: Once an order has shipped, customer self-service cancellation may no longer be available. The Foundation office can still cancel, refund or replace an order from the admin desk, including after delivery, where that is appropriate.

sections.title: How to request a cancellation
sections.body: Open the order in your account, or write to info@vaidyagogate.org with the order number. Approved cancellations are confirmed by email.
